_note: Coverage source for the redirect_uri probe. Two things live here that used
to be implicit in probe_redirect_uri.py and could not be audited:
expects_login   Does this service have Google SSO at all? A service that
declares true and has no working login endpoint is a
old code called that NO_LOGIN and excluded it from BAD, so
a site could lose its login endpoint and the gate still
canonical_origin  The origin the callback MUST point at. Every generated
ADD line is built from this plus the callback path — never
from the URI the app currently emits, which may be stale.
A worker found in _registry/cf-deploy-configs but absent here is UNDECLARED
and blocks (see unknown_service_expects_login). That is deliberate: the fix
is one line in this file, and the alternative is a new deployment silently
